Note 5: [b][color=#ff7700]Old weapons[/color][/b] in your inventory and chests [color=#ff0000]will not be affected[/color] if the mod is newly-installed mid-save. Bring them to [b][color=#00ff00]Clint's Shop[/color][/b] to "[b][color=#ffff00]resharpen[/color][/b]" the weapons. This will allow the weapons to obtain the stronger stats, such as higher attack damage.[/size]

HOW TO FIX: Download the [color=#ffff00]optional file[/color] "[color=#00ff00]Combat Overhaul [b]No Special Attacks [/b]Version[/color]" instead.

[size=6][b]How do I [color=#ff0000]disable[/color] one part of the mod manually?
[/b][/size]
[spoiler]

There is no way to disable some parts of the mod using the mod settings or in-game configuration menu. If you want to disable a part or parts of the mod, follow the steps below.


In this example, we will try to disable the changes in Weapon Special Attacks. But you can also turn off the changes in Mine Rewards and Slingshot Stats/Ammo through the same process.

[size=3]Steps to turn off a part of the mod:[/size]


1. Go to your Mods folder.

2. Open the folder named zz Modified Combat

3. Rename the folder "[AMF] Modified Weapon Special Attacks" into ".[AMF] Modified Weapon Special Attacks"

Just add a period/dot ( [size=5].[/size] ) in front of the file name, before "[AMF}". Deleting the whole [AMF] folder will also work, but it is not recommended.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29284/29284-1752990391-292164158.png[/img]

4. Open the game and test it out. The game should now load the mods without the Modified Weapons Special Attacks folder. Thus, changes in the special attacks will be disabled.

If you want to turn it on again, just rename the file and remove the period/dot ( [size=5].[/size] ) in front of the file name.  The downside is, you have to do the steps again if you update the mod files.[/spoiler]
